description: Returns the founder’s saved Programscape plan: their answers, named company and plan choices, the programs they kept or set aside, and each kept program’s team-reported progress, next action, result note and lifecycle dates (a kept program says whether the founder marked it approved; an approved one carries the expiration date and award the founder entered, and its last reported balance and reminder number, when it has them), and their review as it stands today on those answers. For an account with multiple plans, an omitted plan id returns named choices and requires a selection. For a returning founder asking where things stand or what to do next. Needs the founder’s Programscape sign-in.

planId.description: The selected saved plan. Required when the account has more than one plan; an omitted id never chooses the most recently updated one.

name: my_plan
title: Read the founder’s saved plan
